static_findings: Official personal connector creation is followed by native environment checks, triggerUpdate and local readiness.
The model tool catalog is sourced from neotix.mcp.getAllTools, independently of cloud connector creation.
Sandbox commands have separate connect, disconnect and release lifecycle operations and conditional acknowledgements.
verified_offline_behaviors: Native device events reach Responses JSON/SSE without the text tool prompt, decoder or legacy history planner.
One generation spans multiple function_call and function_call_output exchanges using original upstream call IDs.
Tool outputs are uploaded as native connector MCP results; no follow-up generation or prompt carries the result.
Missing heartbeat prevents generation; invalid ACK, schema, agent or sandbox terminates the run.
Unknown, duplicate, missing, cross-scope and conflicting outputs are rejected before upload.
Partial or uncertain uploads are terminal and are never retried.
Pending tools expire without another request; replacing or deleting snapshots closes old streams.
Cancelled requests still waiting for headers retain the device slot until their reader exits.
Sandbox lifecycle is never falsely acknowledged as successful.
